_comment: Retrieval quality floor. CI runs `python evals/run_retrieval.py --memory --check`
and fails when any metric drops below these values (tolerance 0.005).
These are the measured results of the default configuration: hash-512 dense
+ sparse lexical vectors fused with RRF, then reranked lexically, k=5 over the
Lowering a number here is a deliberate act: do it in the same commit as the
change that caused it, and say in the message why the trade-off is worth it.
LLM-judged floor, checked manually with `python -m evals.run_ragas --check --control`
(never in CI: every score is a judge-model call, and it is not deterministic).
floor: the clean answers' mean faithfulness must not fall below this.
control_gap: the same answers with fabricated claims appended must score at
least this much lower - that is what proves the judge itself catches invention.
Both carry headroom below the measured values; tighten only from a recorded run.
